frame: +X east, +Y up, -Z north, metres, origin at the viewpoint on the ground

mesh.method: RTIN over a 2049 x 2049 polar grid (0.8 m to 40 km), silhouette error 0.080 degrees of elevation seen from the viewing spot

grid.note: float32 y of vertex i * n_r + j: azimuth i * 360 / n_az (from north, clockwise), radius 0 for j = 0, else r_min * (r_max / r_min) ** ((j - 1) / (n_r - 2))

cloud_height.format: uint8, tens of metres above sea, row 0 north, column 0 west
